findings.title: Goods and services figure differs from supporting schedules
findings.summary: Use of goods and services of Kshs.833,700,555 did not agree with supporting schedules of Kshs.1,029,609,581; the Kshs.195,909,026 difference was not explained.

findings.title: Unsupported refund to National Treasury in employee costs
findings.summary: Compensation to employees included Kshs.134,273,123 described as a refund to the National Treasury that was not supported, so its propriety and accuracy could not be confirmed.

findings.title: Unexplained difference in acquisition of assets
findings.summary: Acquisition of assets of Kshs.704,157,170 differed from supporting schedules of Kshs.715,916,197 by Kshs.11,759,027, which management did not explain.

findings.title: Outstanding staff imprests at year end
findings.summary: Imprests of Kshs.2,403,318 advanced to staff had not been surrendered or accounted for by 30 June 2014.

findings.title: Assets and liabilities of defunct local authorities not included
findings.summary: The statements did not include assets and liabilities inherited from the defunct Local Authorities, which the Transition Authority had not formally handed over; pending bills of Kshs.944,242,542 were disclosed in Annex A.

findings.title: No assets register maintained since inception
findings.summary: No assets register was maintained for assets owned since inception, including Kshs.806,718,242 of assets bought in the period.

findings.title: Ambulance tender awarded to second-lowest bidder
findings.summary: Five ambulances costing Kshs.33,000,000 were bought by request for quotations and awarded to the second-lowest bidder without explanation; the auditor states the county would have saved Kshs.9,988,000 had the lowest bidder been chosen.

findings.title: Casual worker payments without muster rolls
findings.summary: Documents for Kshs.14,306,000 paid to temporary employees in February 2014 were not availed, so propriety could not be confirmed.

findings.title: Motorcycle procurement by restricted tender without evaluation records
findings.summary: Fifty-five motorcycles costing Kshs.11,464,860 were procured by restricted tender with no records of evaluation, contrary to section 73(2) of the Public Procurement and Disposal Act, 2005.

findings.title: Unpaid KRA tax arrears claim
findings.summary: KRA claimed Kshs.8,755,276 in tax arrears for July 2012 to April 2013; Kshs.1,377,481 principal was paid and penalties and interest remained pending.

findings.title: Stores not recorded in stores ledger
findings.summary: Stores of Kshs.7,672,540 were bought; computers and toners of Kshs.6,019,200 were not recorded in the stores ledger and there was no beneficiary list for dust coats of Kshs.863,350.

findings.title: Outstanding imprests, some dating to May 2013
findings.summary: Outstanding imprests totalled Kshs.6,438,868 at 30 June 2014, some dating back to May 2013, with no clear efforts to have them surrendered.

findings.title: Travel and accommodation allowances not supported
findings.summary: Travel and accommodation payments of Kshs.6,201,420 were not supported by travel documents, payee signatures, attendance schedules or invitation letters.

findings.title: Staff payments not acknowledged by recipients
findings.summary: Payments to staff of Kshs.5,206,000 were not acknowledged by the payees, so it could not be confirmed that the expenditure was properly incurred.

findings.title: Travel and hospitality charged to unrelated budget lines
findings.summary: Payments of Kshs.5,079,077 for travel and hospitality were charged to unrelated items such as access roads, resulting in unauthorised re-allocation of funds.

findings.title: Employee costs above 35% limit
findings.summary: Employee costs of Kshs.1,927,809,441 were 39.6% of the revenue budget, above the 35% limit.

findings.title: 27 projects stalled or abandoned
findings.summary: Of 177 budgeted projects, 27 costing Kshs.277,393,803 had stalled or been abandoned at 30 June 2017.

findings.title: Pending bills rose to Kshs.205 million
findings.summary: Pending bills totalled Kshs.205,040,544, up Kshs.115,798,963 from the prior year, some dating back to 2013/2014.

findings.title: Local revenue below target
findings.summary: Against a target of Kshs.198,230,100 only Kshs.126,461,992 was collected, an under-collection of Kshs.71,768,108 (36%).

findings.title: Kemasare and Bomwagamo Nyamusi water projects delayed
findings.summary: Kshs.30,208,895 was paid for the Kemasare and Bomwagamo Nyamusi water projects; both were incomplete and over 13 months behind schedule in January 2018.
findings.project: Kemasare and Bomwagamo Nyamusi Water Projects

findings.title: Six vehicles bought without quotations or log books
findings.summary: Six vehicles worth Kshs.29,654,600 were bought; two without quotations, models were specified contrary to procurement law, and log books were not availed.

findings.title: Decline in local revenue
findings.summary: Locally generated revenue declined by Kshs.27,226,638 compared with 2015/16, with no explanation from management.

findings.title: Unexplained 367% rise in temporary staff wages
findings.summary: Wages for temporary employees rose by Kshs.25,848,853 (367%) to Kshs.32,888,704 with no analysis or explanation.

findings.title: Expenditure charged to unbudgeted items without re-allocation approval
findings.summary: Kshs.15,482,527 was charged to items that were not budgeted for or approved for re-allocation.

findings.title: Stalled Doctors Plaza construction
findings.summary: Kshs.13,257,183.45 was paid for wards and doctors' offices whose construction had stalled at first-floor level.

findings.title: Unbudgeted payment to Council of Governors
findings.summary: Kshs.12,500,000 was paid to the Council of Governors without County Assembly approval or budget; the auditor described it as nugatory expenditure.

findings.title: Full advance payment for Manga stadium levelling
findings.summary: Kshs.10,138,500 was paid to the Mechanical Transport Fund for levelling Manga stadium in June 2017; work had not started by January 2018.

findings.title: Poorly installed culverts on Bokimo-Masare road
findings.summary: Of a Kshs.9,969,272 culverts contract, a culvert on Bokimo-Masare Road in Bonyamatuta ward was poorly installed and others were washed away.
findings.project: Culverts and drainage works, Bokimo-Masare Road

findings.title: Kebirigo terminal works not done as planned
findings.summary: For the Kshs.9,700,476 Kebirigo terminal contract, market road repairs were not done; instead a 4.9 km Kebirigo-Bokimo road was murramed.

findings.title: Laundry machine purchase with inconsistent documents
findings.summary: Kshs.8,500,000 was paid for a laundry machine; the agreement post-dated the LPO and documents referred to theatre equipment.

findings.title: Prior-year air tickets paid without procurement records
findings.summary: Air tickets of Kshs.4,005,258 relating to 2015/16 were paid to a local tour company though not in prior pending bills and without procurement records.

findings.title: Events management services procured outside due process
findings.summary: Events management services of Kshs.3,999,860 were procured above the quotation threshold, from non-prequalified firms, and paid from the emergency vote without budget.

findings.title: Fuel purchases without fuel registers or work tickets
findings.summary: Fuel of Kshs.2,943,060 paid by Health and the Office of the Governor lacked fuel registers, detail orders and work tickets.

findings.title: Renovation of National Government offices
findings.summary: Kshs.1,119,629 was spent renovating the County Commissioner's offices, a National Government property, without any compensation arrangement.

findings.title: Travel to Nairobi forum on Kiabonyoru university
findings.summary: Kshs.1,087,200 was paid to staff and MCAs for a Nairobi forum on the proposed Kiabonyoru university without a signed payment list; the auditor described it as wasteful.

findings.title: Deputy Governor fire-fighting training trip to USA
findings.summary: Kshs.964,600 was paid for the Deputy Governor's emergency training in the USA without boarding pass evidence or explanation why local training was not used.

findings.title: Outstanding imprest
findings.summary: Imprests of Kshs.615,863 were outstanding at year end; Kshs.123,158 remained unsurrendered by February 2018.

findings.title: Bank reconciliation balances differ from financial statements
findings.summary: Balances in bank reconciliations for three accounts (retention, development and mortgage) differed from the financial statements without explanation, and the Loans and Mortgages Fund statements were not submitted for audit.

findings.title: Revenue collection not automated
findings.summary: Revenue collection for sources such as the bus park, single business permits and market fees was not automated, increasing the risk of leakage and under-banking.

findings.title: ICT steering and strategic committees not established
findings.summary: The County had not established ICT steering and strategic committees.

findings.title: 94% of staff from dominant ethnic community
findings.summary: 3,885 of 4,150 employees (94%) were from the dominant community, contrary to section 65(e) of the County Governments Act.

findings.title: Budget under-absorption without explanation
findings.summary: The Executive under-spent Kshs.1,337,332,517 (recurrent) and Kshs.673,852,066 (development) without explanatory notes.

findings.title: Financial statement receipts differ from IFMIS reports
findings.summary: Exchequer releases differed from IFMIS by Kshs.2,264,094,000, and own-generated receipts (Kshs.97,881,577) and returned CRF issues (Kshs.834,304,744) did not appear in IFMIS.

findings.title: Pending bills not supported by documents
findings.summary: Pending bills for goods and services of Kshs.347,696,209 (plus Kshs.114,008,711 due to the County Assembly) lacked contracts, orders, invoices and schedules.

findings.title: Wage bill at 45% of revenue, above regulatory limit
findings.summary: Employee costs of Kshs.2,358,813,516 were 45% of total revenue, contravening regulation 25(1)(b) of the PFM (County Governments) Regulations, 2015.

findings.title: Development budget 64% unspent
findings.summary: Development spending was Kshs.684,179,549 against a budget of Kshs.1,888,801,377, an under-expenditure of Kshs.1,204,621,828, and differed from IFMIS by Kshs.13,704,124.45.

findings.title: Leased medical equipment payments without agreement
findings.summary: Kshs.576,000,000 has been paid for leased medical equipment since 2014/15; the agreement was not provided and the deduction rose from Kshs.95 million to Kshs.200 million without explanation.

findings.title: Recurrent budget under-spent by Kshs.408 million
findings.summary: Recurrent spending was Kshs.3,814,767,524 against a budget of Kshs.4,222,896,206, an under-expenditure of Kshs.408,128,682.

findings.title: Roads department implemented 44% of development budget
findings.summary: The Transport, Roads and Public Works department spent Kshs.253,323,829.50 of Kshs.569,441,081; many projects done were unbudgeted and some spending related to 2016/17 pending bills.

findings.title: 83 education projects from 2015/16 uncompleted
findings.summary: 83 projects (ECD centres and youth polytechnics) allocated Kshs.234,187,055.25 and started in 2015/16 remained uncompleted after contract periods expired.

findings.title: Own-source revenue collected at 38% of target
findings.summary: Own-source revenue was Kshs.97,881,577 against a target of Kshs.258,592,832 (Kshs.160,711,225 unrealised); 27 of 56 approved streams recorded nothing.

findings.title: Scholarships below 2.5% Education Act threshold
findings.summary: Scholarships of Kshs.121,075,293 did not reach the 2.5% of annual budget required by the Nyamira County Education Act, 2016.

findings.title: 26 environment projects not done
findings.summary: Twenty-six environment department projects estimated at Kshs.87,325,224 had not been done by year end.

findings.title: Youth and Sports development budget not implemented
findings.summary: Projects under the Kshs.70,748,445 development budget of the Youth, Sports, Gender, Culture and Social Services department had not been implemented by 30 June 2018.

findings.title: Manga Stadium Complex incomplete three years after deadline
findings.summary: The Kshs.62,393,384 Manga Stadium contract (8 months from March 2015) was about 60% complete in October 2018 with Kshs.44,138,500 paid and the contractor off site.

findings.title: Outstanding land rates and plot rent
findings.summary: Twenty-five organisations owed Kshs.40,110,225 in land rates and plot rent, some since 2013, with no evidence of recovery steps.

findings.title: Prefabricated office blocks behind schedule
findings.summary: The Kshs.36,072,230 prefabricated office blocks contract was far behind schedule in October 2018, with block A not started.
findings.project: Prefabricated office blocks A and B

findings.title: Single business permit under-collection; no business registers
findings.summary: Single business permit receipts were Kshs.24,109,734 below budget, and checks at Keroka, Borabu and Nyansiongo found no complete business registers.

findings.title: Recruitment of 736 officers without supporting documents
findings.summary: No recruitment records were provided for 736 officers employed in the year, a payroll rise of Kshs.3,091,818 was unsupported, and 1,565 officers had been on probation beyond six months; employee costs were Kshs.2,885,941,270.

findings.title: Returned CRF issues not supported by supplementary budget
findings.summary: Returned County Revenue Fund issues of Kshs.1,101,374,293 were not supported by a supplementary budget showing how the funds would be used.

findings.title: CBK balance not supported by statements or reconciliations
findings.summary: Cash of Kshs.1,017,220,344 at the Central Bank, within a total of Kshs.1,428,139,359, was not supported by bank statements, reconciliations or a certificate of balance.

findings.title: County headquarters contractor abandoned site
findings.summary: Of a Kshs.382,970,401 county headquarters contract, Kshs.32,523,000 was paid; in September 2019 the contractor had abandoned the site and no documents explained why.

findings.title: Wage bill at 51% of receipts
findings.summary: Employee costs of Kshs.2,885,941,270 were 51% of total receipts, above the 35% limit in the PFM (County Governments) Regulations, 2015.

findings.title: Lands department: one of 30 projects started, then abandoned
findings.summary: The Lands, Housing and Physical Planning development budget of Kshs.194,610,482 was for 30 projects, but only the County Headquarters (Kshs.23,523,000) was started and later abandoned.

findings.title: Agriculture development budget under-absorbed
findings.summary: Agriculture spent Kshs.73,802,611 of its development budget, leaving Kshs.186,368,096 unabsorbed, with an unexplained Kshs.3,000,000 project list variance and late poultry and vegetable supplies.

findings.title: Three health and ECDE contracts delayed, contractors off site
findings.summary: Contracts worth Kshs.132,663,903 for Magwagwa Health Centre, Nyamusi Sub-County Hospital wards and Geseneno ECDE centre were incomplete with contractors off site in September 2019.
findings.project: Magwagwa Health Centre; Nyamusi Sub-County Hospital; Geseneno ECDE Centre

findings.title: Road Maintenance Levy projects not completed or started
findings.summary: Of 44 Road Maintenance Levy Fund projects (Kshs.125,663,278) only 21 were completed; culvert and drainage projects worth Kshs.71,950,005 had not started.

findings.title: Environment and water budget largely unspent
findings.summary: Of 156 planned environment and water projects only spring protection in five wards (Kshs.12,290,000) was done, leaving Kshs.122,762,235 unspent; sampled water projects were incomplete.

findings.title: Roads programmes implemented outside approved budget
findings.summary: Roads programmes worth Kshs.80,076,003 were implemented though not in the approved budget.

findings.title: Machinery hire paid to MTF largely unused
findings.summary: Kshs.73,955,800 was paid to the Mechanical and Transport Fund for machinery hire, but only Kshs.16,423,264 (22%) had been used by year end.

findings.title: Bursary Fund under-funded against Education Act
findings.summary: Kshs.131,500,000 was transferred to the Bursary Fund against a legal threshold of Kshs.161,776,406, an under-funding of Kshs.30,276,406.

findings.title: Pending bills not settled despite surplus
findings.summary: Pending bills of Kshs.91,612,706 were carried forward although the Executive had a Kshs.1,428,211,479 surplus (Other Matter).

findings.title: Own-source revenue Kshs.90 million below target; 2006 valuation roll
findings.summary: Own-source revenue was Kshs.165,447,568 against Kshs.255,566,158 budgeted, and land rates were still collected using a 2006 draft valuation roll (Other Matter).

findings.summary: Appendix II lists Kemasare Water Project with Kshs.26,832,300 spent to date and the project incomplete.

findings.summary: Appendix II lists Nyandoche Ibere Water Project with Kshs.7,901,190 spent to date and the project incomplete.

findings.summary: Appendix II lists Ekoro Water Project with Kshs.6,814,051 spent to date and the project incomplete.

findings.summary: Appendix II lists Bosiango Borehole Project with Kshs.3,949,336 spent to date and the project incomplete.

findings.title: Kiamarita Borehole Project incomplete at verification
findings.summary: Appendix II lists Kiamarita Borehole Project with Kshs.3,227,120 spent to date and the project incomplete.

findings.title: Asset register incomplete; defunct councils' assets excluded
findings.summary: The asset register behind Kshs.4,915,394,131 of historical cost lacked acquisition dates and costs and excluded assets from defunct local authorities.

findings.title: Wage bill at 45% of receipts
findings.summary: Employee costs of Kshs.2,730,317,480 were 45% of receipts, above the 35% ratio in Regulation 25(1)(b).

findings.title: Forty projects incomplete at audit
findings.summary: Forty projects budgeted at Kshs.378,299,813, with Kshs.275,987,745 spent, were incomplete in October 2020.

findings.title: Ninety contracted projects not implemented
findings.summary: Ninety projects valued at Kshs.320,138,261 contracted during the year were not implemented.

findings.title: Borabu Inn-Nyabite road upgrade half done after deadline
findings.summary: The Kshs.104,373,213.30 KUSP upgrade of the 13.95 km B5 Borabu Inn-Golani Heights-Nyamira Boys-Nyabite Market road was 50% done after its August 2020 deadline.

findings.title: COVID-19 isolation complex via restricted tender, not started
findings.summary: A Kshs.95,860,834 contract for a 160-bed isolation complex at Nyamira County Referral Hospital was awarded by restricted tender contrary to section 91(1) PPADA, and works had not started in November 2020.
findings.project: 160-bed COVID-19 isolation complex, Nyamira County Referral Hospital

findings.title: Eleven prior-year projects stalled
findings.summary: Eleven projects contracted in the previous year at Kshs.95,572,787 had stalled with no works ongoing.

findings.title: KRA tax arrears overpaid
findings.summary: Kshs.92,289,456 was paid to KRA for tax arrears and penalties against a demand of Kshs.91,111,125, an unexplained overpayment of Kshs.1,178,331; the auditor described the penalties as wasteful.

findings.title: Own-source revenue shortfall of Kshs.62.7 million
findings.summary: Own-source revenue was Kshs.187,324,098 against Kshs.250,000,000; the auditor cites a 2006 valuation roll, land rent arrears and incomplete automation.

findings.title: Bursary grants below 2.5% Education Act threshold
findings.summary: Scholarship grants of Kshs.126,520,000 were Kshs.48,529,419 below the 2.5% of budget required by the Nyamira County Education Act, 2016.

findings.title: Land rent arrears outstanding since 2010
findings.summary: Land rent arrears of Kshs.44,444,313 (principal Kshs.34,185,004 and penalties Kshs.10,259,309) had been outstanding since 2010 with no evidence of collection effort.

findings.title: Budget shortfall and own-source revenue 25% below target
findings.summary: Receipts fell short of budget by Kshs.927,100,072, spending was Kshs.1,005,502,147 below budget, and own-source revenue was Kshs.187,324,098 against Kshs.250,000,000 (Other Matter).

findings.title: Revenue collection system 15 months late
findings.summary: A Kshs.39,500,000 revenue system (Kshs.19,750,000 paid) was 15 months behind schedule, and Kshs.94,660,809 of revenue was collected outside the electronic system.

findings.summary: Appendix lists Motorumesi and Rigoma Markets Shades (contract Kshs.7,037,752, paid Kshs.7,037,752) as completed but not put to use.

findings.title: Nyabite Market: stalled
findings.summary: Appendix lists Nyabite Market (contract Kshs.4,515,300, paid Kshs.2,715,165) as stalled, contractor not on site.

findings.summary: Appendix lists Kiendege Talent Academy twin house (contract Kshs.3,934,509, paid Kshs.1,674,483) as stalled, contractor not on site.

findings.summary: Appendix lists Matiero Primary ECDE classrooms and pit latrine (contract Kshs.3,600,000, paid Kshs.3,275,200) as stalled, contractor not on site.

findings.summary: Appendix lists Gesore Primary ECDE classrooms (contract Kshs.2,729,130, paid Kshs.1,105,886) as stalled, contractor not on site.

findings.title: Raitigo Youth Polytechnic classrooms and toilets: incomplete
findings.summary: Appendix lists Raitigo Youth Polytechnic classrooms and toilets (contract Kshs.2,702,220, paid Kshs.2,702,220) as incomplete.
findings.project: Raitigo Youth Polytechnic classrooms and toilets
